newsitem.title: USA: Bio-Vascular seeks FDA nod on device.
newsitem.headline: Bio-Vascular seeks FDA nod on device.

text.p: Bio-Vascular Inc said Thursday it filed with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for approval of Petri-Strips Dry, an advanced version of its Petri-Strips product.
Petri-Strips are used to reinforce the surgical staple-line and prevent leakage of air during and after lung volume reduction surgery for treating late-stage emphysema.
The new product is affixed to surgical staplers using hydrogel developed by Bio-Vascular called PSD Gel.
Bio-Vascular manufactures and markets proprietary specialty medical products.
